files.repo/README.md:
# Report Formatter
Use `just check` for the canonical check-only gate.
files.repo/justfile:
check: fmt lint typecheck test

fmt:
    python3 -m ruff format --check .

lint:
    python3 -m ruff check .

typecheck:
    python3 -m mypy src

test:
    python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
files.repo/src/formatter.py:
def format_report(value: str) -> str:
    return value.strip()
